question.text: The <math><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow></msub></math> of acetic acid and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi></mrow></msub></math> of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math> are 4.75 and 4.75 respectively. Find the pH of ammonium acetate solution?

solution.text:
Ammonium acetate is a salt of weak acid and weak base.

So pH is given as

pH=12pKw+pKa-pKb

=1214+4.75-4.75

=7
